title: [Bug] Using edit config for mcp management doesn't seem to work
body:
#### Describe the bug

I went to Tools and clicked Edit Config and pasted in my mcp config with a couple tools in it from another client (roo code), and then clicked save.  It doesn't seem like this did anything?  No new tools show up on the page.  I closed the app and re-opened it, then went to edit config again and my changes were gone.

However, adding the same tools using the "Add MCP Server" button does work and the new tools show up immediately.
author: justyns

comments.body: @justyns  Normally, after clicking the Save button, it will load. May I ask if your reaction when clicking it shows any change or no response? Or perhaps the JSON is just missing the outer curly braces {}.

@justyns  Thank you for your test. For the `Add MCP Server` button, we hope users can directly paste the JSON from other MCP Server README pages, so we've done some processing. `Edit Config` is more like editing the original configuration file.
